digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / bugfix-size attestation gate (code review)
propositions: Bug fixes under the 150-line threshold are not escalated to plan review even when they touch files fixed multiple times recently, missing high-risk repeat-fix patterns.

A new repeat-fix signal (≥2 prior bug-fix commits on the same non-test file within 7 days) catches 12 of 22 labelled repeat-fix bugs at 34.8% escalation, compared to the size floor catching 10 at 16.3%.

The size floor and repeat-fix predicate must both escalate independently; the repeat-fix verdict is a separate coverage field, not folded into the legacy flagged field, to preserve the pinned --check-planning-corpus invariant.

Unit tests pin that under-floor diffs with no prior fixes perform no store reads, but must allow store reads when repeat-fix conditions are met; one existing test must be rewritten to reflect this new invariant.

The git history walk for repeat fixes must exclude merge commits, count only bug-type tickets, operate per-path (not across paths), and anchor to the base ref (not wall-clock now) to avoid false positives and enable backtest reproducibility.
